Pipeline Team For Vets For Partners News Contact Get updates For veterinarians Help shape the medicines your patients need next. Familiar is building a new generation of medicines for companion animals, informed by the veterinarians who care for them. Whether you're interested in clinical trials, want to share an unmet need, or simply want to connect with our team, we'd love to hear from you. Get involved OUR APPROACH Translated from human medicine. Many diseases in dogs and cats share underlying biology with human disease. Familiar starts with drug candidates whose targets and mechanisms are already understood in people, then does the translational work required to determine whether they can become veterinary medicines.
